title: EmuCoreV Android | Test 27 Games | Snapdragon 870.
summary: A 27-game EmuCoreV survey on an Oppo Find X3 with Snapdragon 870, 8 GB RAM and a Gamesir controller, using a chaptered title list to expose breadth rather than one showcase game.

blocks.text: Eduard I22 publishes the entire workload: Borderlands 2, Gravity Rush, Uncharted, Mortal Kombat, Injustice, both God of War collections, Dragon's Crown, Odin Sphere, Street Fighter X Tekken and numerous fighters, action games and RPGs appear in timestamped segments. All are shown on an Oppo Find X3 with Snapdragon 870, 8 GB RAM and a Gamesir T4 Nova Lite. This wide genre spread makes the recording a useful compatibility survey for one mature Adreno platform, especially when a viewer wants to jump directly to a named title.

Breadth is not the same as validation depth. Most chapters last roughly a minute, and the description does not publish the EmuCoreV build, GPU driver, renderer, resolution, game regions, shader-cache state or completion status. A title reaching gameplay does not prove that later stages, saving or graphics remain correct. Treat each timestamp as a triage lead for Snapdragon 870, then reproduce the exact scene and continue beyond the showcased segment before recording a compatibility judgment.
